title: PPT Design
description: Deck-wide visual design requirements and shared decoration placement.

decorations.description: Shared decoration positions. Every non-none position may be assigned to only one decoration, even when its text is currently missing; conflicting configurations are rejected. Text is derived from presentation resources; Runtime and the theme control appearance.

page_number.description: Placement of the numeric page number derived from outline order. It is always shown, including on cover and conclusion pages; none is not allowed.

section_title.description: Placement of the current top-level section title from the outline, not the subsection title. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

deck_title.description: Placement of the presentation title from Manifest.title. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

key_message.description: Placement of the current page's core message from its Spec.core. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

demands.description: Visual design requirements that page authoring must follow throughout this presentation. Record independently actionable natural-language requirements covering overall look, information density, layout and hierarchy, text/image expression, use of visual elements, reference and brand constraints, or motion. Items may include conditions, preferences or explicit prohibitions; do not require every dimension. Record actual project requirements only, not generic quality rules or copies of the selected theme's existing configuration. Keep content requirements in Manifest and a single page's arrangement in its Spec. Explicit palette or typography requirements must be fulfilled through available theme capabilities; explain unsupported requests. Changing this list updates authoring guidance, not existing HTML. Supplying it replaces the list completely; use [] when unspecified or to clear it.

items.description: One independent, explicit and actionable deck-wide visual design requirement, optionally with conditions, a preference or a prohibition.

demands: 整体专业克制，以结构示意图和流程关系解释概念。
少用卡片，优先通过留白和对齐区分内容
